headline: Trilegal, Sheppard act on $310 million acquisition of iMerit by EXL
sum: ExlService Holdings, Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire iMerit in a transaction valued at up to $310 million in upfront and future consideration.
detail: ExlService Holdings, Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire iMerit in a transaction valued at up to $310 million in upfront and future consideration. Trilegal advised iMerit and its shareholders on this transaction. The Firm's scope included advising on various structuring aspects of the transaction, including structuring pertaining to treatment of outstanding ESOPs of iMerit, and negotiating and finalising the share purchase agreement and ancillary documentation, including disclosure schedules, restrictive covenant agreements, and employment agreements.
